Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1,
to be performed on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.
The first draft is initiated by eng. Ahmad Alokabi, tested by 
eng. Tarek EL-kafafy, accepted by general director eng. Nady Mosaed, approved by 
eng. Mohamed EL-Tahawy Head sector of Shoubra EL-Kheima PS.
This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha, CEPC quality control director, and certified by 
eng. Afaf Ebrahim el Dib,
CEPC inspection & quality control 's head sector and MPIS coordinator
Safety Precautions
A
 work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category
Wear
 your safety helmet & safety shoes.
Safety
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.
The circuit breaker in service.
Tools and Equipment
Electrical
 tool box .
Gas
 leak detector .
An
 industrial vacuum cleaner .
Work to be Carried Out
Clean the outside surface with the industrial vacuum cleaner
Tighten loose bolts or nuts
Check the ground wire & tighten if necessary
Check gas pressure to be 6 atm
Check oil pressure to be 320 atm
Check oil level 
in accordance with fig (1)
Check for gas or oil leak
Record on/off operation counter
Record the oil pump operation counter.
